compute_r_indicator: compute the R-indicator from sample and target response propensities to measure survey representativeness
calculate_asmd: calculate the absolute standardized mean deviation between sample and target DataFrames with optional weights
calculate_kld: calculate the Kullback-Leibler divergence between sample and target DataFrames for discrete and continuous columns
calculate_emd: calculate the Earth Mover's Distance between sample and target DataFrames using weighted Wasserstein distance
calculate_asmd_improvement: calculate the improvement in mean ASMD before and after applying weight adjustments to a sample
